title: testjig: object-history Session capability, _with_history registration, spec examples end to end
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H11. Crates: jmap-testjig. Size: M.

Spec: object-history-03 §2.1 (Session capability {} iff some account has it; account capability), §3.2.1, §3.2.2, §4.1, §5.3. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §5 'Capability advertisement', §10.

Work:
- In crate-jmap-testjig/src/http.rs, switch mail (plus sieve), contacts, calendars, filenode and tasks to register_<x>_handlers_with_history, with memory with_object_history.
- If conditional C11 has landed, keep register_<x>_conditional AFTER the _with_history call (decision 1 composition). Whichever bead lands second fixes the order.
- Advertise capabilities[URI] = {} and accountCapabilities[URI] from object_history_capability.
- Add the URI to check_known_capabilities.
- Assert Dispatcher::object_history_gaps is empty for the advertised supportedTypes.

Acceptance:
- Over HTTP, the §3.2.1, §3.2.2, §4.1 and §5.3 examples match hand-written JSON (except state).
- The Session has the URI in capabilities exactly when an account has it.
- The gap assertion test passes.
